## Personality

Jane is a steady, plain, and plodding individual known for her sensible and conscientious nature. She possesses an amiable and placid demeanor, presenting herself as a nice, lady-like, and practical woman who is considerate enough to avoid hurting others' feelings. Though dutiful in her endeavors, she can be strict with her pupils and is noted for being crosser than [Anne](../character/anne.md). Initially motivated to devote her entire life to teaching, earn her salary fairly, please the trustees, and reach the School Inspector's roll of honor without ever marrying, she eventually marries and proves to be exceptionally skilled at cooking.

## History

[Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) grew up in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), joining [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's story club as a child and later studying in the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) preparation class. After passing the entrance examination for Queen's, she attended school and college alongside [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md). Later, Jane took a job teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. During an autumn walk with [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), Jane explored [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden and enjoyed a spring birthday picnic. Soon after, Jane and her friends attempted to persuade [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fences for patent medicine ads, though Parker initially refused them. Years later, Jane hosted [Anne](../character/anne.md) for an overnight visit and delivered a marriage proposal to [Anne](../character/anne.md) on behalf of her shy brother, [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md). After [Anne](../character/anne.md) rejected the offer, Jane coolly accepted the refusal and noted that [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) would likely marry someone else. Jane eventually resigned from her position at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school to go West, stole a march on [Anne](../character/anne.md) by getting married first, and wed a millionaire before departing for a honeymoon in [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe).

## Quotes

> "Wouldn’t it be nice to have three wishes granted you . . . or even only one? What would you wish for, girls, if you could have a wish granted? I’d wish to be rich and beautiful and clever."
>
> — Jane — [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P32](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0032)

> “Oh, Anne,” gasped Jane, as they fled to the girls’ dressing room amid hearty cheers. “Oh, Anne I’m so proud! Isn’t it splendid?”
>
> — Jane — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P8](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0008)

> "Everybody knows what Judson Parker is. He’d do anything for money. He hasn’t a spark of public spirit or any sense of the beautiful."
>
> — Jane — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P41](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0041)

> "Even Levi Boulter or Lorenzo White would never stoop to that, tightfisted as they are. They would have too much respect for public opinion."
>
> — Jane — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P57](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0057)

> "I can’t understand how she could have wanted to live back here, away from everything,"
>
> — Jane — [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P55](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0055)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--jane.md)

Jane and [Anne](../character/anne.md) are childhood friends and classmates who enjoy spending midsummer afternoons together and playing. They collaborate closely as fellow members of the village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) and participated in creative pursuits like the story club as young girls. Their shared social circle also extends to their time together as students in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane.md)

Jane and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are long-standing friends and schoolmates who participate in social activities together, such as working for the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) to protect local scenery. During an overnight stay, Jane acts as an intermediary by delivering a marriage proposal to [Anne](../character/anne.md) on behalf of her brother [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md). When [Anne](../character/anne.md) turns down the offer, Jane accepts the rejection coolly, maintaining her composure and pointing out that [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) will likely marry someone else instead.
